paper.title: Dynamic environments do not appear to constrain spider web building behaviour

apparatus.amplitude_convention_note: For affine shear, a 40 degree swing gives 30*tan(20 degrees) = 10.92 cm peak displacement. This supports the approximately 10 cm peak convention; 5 cm remains an apparatus-sensitivity condition. Flexible-frame deformation is not exactly affine.
